questionnaire.name: SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Motorcycle Travel

welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Experience With Motorcycle Travel
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire asks about how you feel and what you experience while travelling by motorcycle or scooter. Your answers help identify barriers and opportunities for better urban mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questionnaire.title: 6. Your Experience With Motorcycle Travel

sections.title: Motorcycle and scooter use
sections.description: Questions about whether you ride a motorcycle, scooter or moped and how the road affects your riding.

questions.text: Do you ride a motorcycle, scooter or moped at least once a week to get to places? (E-scooters do not count here: they are covered in the cycling questionnaire.)
Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scooter, or why do you ride so rarely? (Select all that apply)
questions.help: We ask this to understand what limits the use of motorcycles and scooters for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

options.text: I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better
I don't have a licence or a vehicle
It feels too dangerous in traffic
Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblestones, tram tracks)
My health, a disability or my age makes it difficult

questions.text: How do traffic-calming features (e.g., speed bumps, rumble strips, road narrowings) affect your sense of safety while riding?
questions.help: Rumble strips are raised or grooved lines across the road that make vehicles vibrate. A road narrowing is a point where the carriageway is made narrower.

options.text: Make me feel much less safe
Make me feel slightly less safe

questions.text: How do parked cars or narrow lanes typically impact your ability to maneuver safely on your route?

options.text: No problem, I can handle these situations
Minor inconvenience, I adjust and manage
I have to maneuver with difficulty
I avoid these stretches of road

questions.text: How do road surface conditions (potholes, cobblestones, tram tracks) affect your riding?

options.text: They do not affect my riding
I slow down or change my line, but I feel safe
I avoid some roads because of their surface, even if the route is longer

questions.text: In the last 12 months, have you fallen or nearly fallen because of the road surface?

sections.title: Other road users, parking and charging
sections.description: Questions about other drivers, parking and charging for your vehicle.

questions.text: How confident are you in your ability to avoid crashes caused by “dooring” (car doors opening suddenly) or drivers failing to check blind spots?
questions.help: A blind spot is the area around a vehicle that the driver cannot see in the mirrors.

questions.text: To what extent does the behavior of other drivers (e.g., sudden lane changes, tailgating, or not yielding) affect your stress levels during a trip?
questions.help: Tailgating means following another vehicle at a very short distance.

options.text: Not stressful at all, it doesn't affect me
Slightly stressful, it occasionally bothers me
Moderately stressful, I notice it but manage
Very stressful, it frequently puts me on edge
Extremely stressful, it significantly affects my ability to ride safely

questions.text: How adequate are motorcycle-specific parking facilities in your city? Think about secure parking and designated spaces near destinations.
To what extent does the presence of charging stations (for electric motorcycles/scooters) influence your willingness to use your vehicle?

options.text: I don't have an electric vehicle, so this doesn't apply to me

it.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Mo: SmartUrbanity - La tua esperienza con la moto
it.#6. Your Experience With Motorcycle Trav: 6. La tua esperienza con la moto
it.#Welcome to Your Experience With Motorcy: Benvenuto/a nel questionario sulla tua esperienza con la moto
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#Motorcycle and scooter use: Uso della moto e dello scooter
it.#<p>Questions about whether you ride a m: Domande sull'uso della moto, dello scooter o del motorino e su come la strada influisce sulla tua guida.
it.#Make me feel much less safe: Mi fanno sentire molto meno sicuro/a
it.#Make me feel slightly less safe: Mi fanno sentire leggermente meno sicuro/a
it.#No effect on my safety: Non hanno alcun effetto sulla mia sicurezza
it.#Make me feel slightly safer: Mi fanno sentire leggermente più sicuro/a
it.#Make me feel much safer: Mi fanno sentire molto più sicuro/a
it.#How do parked cars or narrow lanes typi: In che modo le auto parcheggiate o le corsie strette influenzano normalmente la tua capacità di manovrare in sicurezza lungo il percorso?
it.#Minor inconvenience, I adjust and manag: Piccolo disagio, mi adatto e riesco a gestire la situazione
it.#To what extent does the behavior of oth: In che misura il comportamento degli altri conducenti (ad es. cambi improvvisi di corsia, guida troppo ravvicinata o mancata precedenza) influisce sul tuo livello di stress durante uno spostamento?
it.#Tailgating means following another vehi: Per guida troppo ravvicinata intendiamo seguire un altro veicolo a distanza molto ridotta.
it.#Not stressful at all, it doesn't affect: Per niente stressante, non mi influenza
it.#Moderately stressful, I notice it but m: Moderatamente stressante, me ne accorgo ma riesco a gestirlo
it.#Very stressful, it frequently puts me o: Molto stressante, mi mette frequentemente in tensione
it.#Extremely stressful, it significantly a: Estremamente stressante, influisce significativamente sulla mia capacità di guidare in sicurezza
it.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Quanto sono adeguate le strutture di parcheggio dedicate a moto e scooter nella tua città? Considera i parcheggi sicuri e gli spazi riservati vicino alle destinazioni.
it.#To what extent does the presence of cha: In che misura la presenza di stazioni di ricarica per moto o scooter elettrici influenza la tua propensione a utilizzare il tuo veicolo?
it.#I don't have an electric vehicle, so th: Non possiedo un veicolo elettrico, quindi questa domanda non si applica al mio caso
it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity riguarda le tue sensazioni e la tua esperienza durante gli spostamenti in moto o scooter. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a individuare ostacoli e opportunità per migliorare la mobilità urbana. La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#Do you ride a motorcycle, scooter or mo: Guidi una moto, uno scooter o un motorino almeno una volta alla settimana per i tuoi spostamenti? (Il monopattino non conta: è compreso nel questionario sulla bicicletta.)
it.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Perché non usi la moto o lo scooter, o perché li usi così poco? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Lo chiediamo per capire che cosa limita l'uso della moto e dello scooter per persone diverse. Rispondere è facoltativo e puoi anche scegliere di non dirlo.
it.#I don't have a licence or a vehicle: Non ho la patente o il mezzo
it.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: Mi sembra troppo pericoloso nel traffico
it.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: Manto stradale in cattive condizioni (buche, sampietrini, binari del tram)
it.#My health, a disability or my age makes: La mia salute, una disabilità o l'età me lo rendono difficile
it.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Non mi serve: altri modi di spostarmi sono più adatti a me
it.#How do traffic-calming features (e.g.,: In che modo gli interventi di moderazione del traffico (ad es. dossi, bande sonore rallentatrici, restringimenti della carreggiata) influenzano la tua percezione di sicurezza mentre guidi?
it.#Rumble strips are raised or grooved lin: Le bande sonore rallentatrici sono strisce in rilievo o scanalate trasversali alla strada che fanno vibrare i veicoli. Un restringimento della carreggiata è un punto in cui la strada è resa più stretta.
it.#No problem, I can handle these situatio: Nessun problema, riesco a gestire queste situazioni
it.#How do road surface conditions (pothole: In che modo le condizioni del manto stradale (buche, sampietrini, binari del tram) influiscono sulla tua guida?
it.#I slow down or change my line, but I fe: Rallento o cambio traiettoria, ma mi sento al sicuro
it.#I avoid some roads because of their sur: Evito alcune strade per le condizioni del manto, anche se il percorso è più lungo
it.#In the last 12 months, have you fallen: Negli ultimi 12 mesi sei caduto/a o hai rischiato di cadere a causa del manto stradale?
it.#How confident are you in your ability t: Quanto ti senti capace di evitare incidenti causati dall'apertura improvvisa delle portiere delle auto o da conducenti che non controllano gli angoli ciechi?
it.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: L'angolo cieco è la zona intorno a un veicolo che chi guida non riesce a vedere negli specchietti.
it.#Other road users, parking and charging: Altri utenti della strada, parcheggio e ricarica
it.#<p>Questions about other drivers, parki: Domande sugli altri conducenti, sul parcheggio e sulla ricarica del tuo veicolo.

fr.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Mo: SmartUrbanity - Votre expérience en moto ou scooter
fr.#6. Your Experience With Motorcycle Trav: 6. Votre expérience en moto ou scooter
fr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Motorcy: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur votre expérience en moto ou scooter
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#Motorcycle and scooter use: Usage de la moto et du scooter
fr.#<p>Questions about whether you ride a m: Questions pour savoir si vous conduisez une moto, un scooter ou un cyclomoteur et comment la route influence votre conduite.
fr.#Make me feel much less safe: Ils me font sentir beaucoup moins en sécurité
fr.#Make me feel slightly less safe: Ils me font sentir un peu moins en sécurité
fr.#No effect on my safety: Ils n’ont aucun effet sur mon sentiment de sécurité
fr.#Make me feel slightly safer: Ils me font sentir un peu plus en sécurité
fr.#Make me feel much safer: Ils me font sentir beaucoup plus en sécurité
fr.#How do parked cars or narrow lanes typi: Comment les voitures garées ou les voies étroites influencent-elles généralement votre capacité à manœuvrer en sécurité sur votre trajet ?
fr.#Minor inconvenience, I adjust and manag: Petit désagrément : je m’adapte et je peux continuer
fr.#To what extent does the behavior of oth: Dans quelle mesure le comportement des autres conducteurs, par exemple les changements brusques de voie, le fait de suivre de trop près ou de ne pas céder le passage, augmente-t-il votre stress pendant un trajet ?
fr.#Tailgating means following another vehi: Suivre de trop près signifie rouler à très courte distance derrière un autre véhicule.
fr.#Not stressful at all, it doesn't affect: Pas du tout stressant : cela ne m’affecte pas
fr.#Slightly stressful, it occasionally bot: Un peu stressant : cela me gêne parfois
fr.#Moderately stressful, I notice it but m: Modérément stressant : je le remarque, mais je le gère
fr.#Very stressful, it frequently puts me o: Très stressant : cela me met souvent sous tension
fr.#Extremely stressful, it significantly a: Extrêmement stressant : cela réduit fortement ma capacité à conduire en sécurité
fr.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Les possibilités de stationnement réservées aux motos et scooters dans votre ville sont-elles adaptées ? Pensez aux places sûres et aux emplacements réservés près des destinations.
fr.#To what extent does the presence of cha: Dans quelle mesure la présence de bornes de recharge pour motos ou scooters électriques influence-t-elle votre envie d’utiliser votre véhicule ?
fr.#I don't have an electric vehicle, so th: Je n’ai pas de véhicule électrique, donc cette question ne me concerne pas
fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur vos sensations et votre expérience pendant vos déplacements en moto ou en scooter. Vos réponses nous aident à repérer les obstacles et les possibilités d’amélioration de la mobilité urbaine. La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom : elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
fr.#Do you ride a motorcycle, scooter or mo: Conduisez-vous une moto, un scooter ou un cyclomoteur au moins une fois par semaine pour vos déplacements ? (Les trottinettes électriques ne comptent pas ici : elles sont traitées dans le questionnaire sur le vélo.)
fr.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Pourquoi n'utilisez-vous pas de moto ou de scooter, ou pourquoi si rarement ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre ce qui limite l'usage de la moto et du scooter selon les personnes. Répondre est facultatif, et vous pouvez aussi choisir de ne pas le dire.
fr.#I don't have a licence or a vehicle: Je n'ai pas le permis ou pas de véhicule
fr.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: Cela me semble trop dangereux dans la circulation
fr.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: Le mauvais état de la chaussée (nids-de-poule, pavés, rails de tramway)
fr.#Heat or bad weather: La chaleur ou le mauvais temps
fr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Ma santé, un handicap ou mon âge rendent cela difficile
fr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Je n'en ai pas besoin : d'autres moyens de déplacement me conviennent mieux
fr.#How do traffic-calming features (e.g.,: Comment les dispositifs qui ralentissent la circulation, par exemple les ralentisseurs, bandes rugueuses ou rétrécissements de chaussée, influencent-ils votre sentiment de sécurité lorsque vous conduisez ?
fr.#Rumble strips are raised or grooved lin: Les bandes rugueuses sont des lignes en relief ou creusées en travers de la chaussée qui font vibrer les véhicules. Un rétrécissement de chaussée est un endroit où la voie est rendue plus étroite.
fr.#No problem, I can handle these situatio: Aucun problème, je gère ces situations
fr.#How do road surface conditions (pothole: Comment l'état de la chaussée (nids-de-poule, pavés, rails de tramway) influence-t-il votre conduite ?
fr.#I slow down or change my line, but I fe: Je ralentis ou change de trajectoire, mais je me sens en sécurité
fr.#I often feel in danger: Je me sens souvent en danger
fr.#I avoid some roads because of their sur: J'évite certaines routes à cause de leur revêtement, même si le trajet est plus long
fr.#In the last 12 months, have you fallen: Au cours des 12 derniers mois, êtes-vous tombé(e) ou avez-vous failli tomber à cause de l’état de la chaussée ?
fr.#How confident are you in your ability t: À quel point vous sentez-vous capable d’éviter un accident causé par une portière de voiture qui s’ouvre soudainement ou par un conducteur qui ne vérifie pas son angle mort ?
fr.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: L'angle mort est la zone autour d'un véhicule que le conducteur ne peut pas voir dans ses rétroviseurs.
fr.#Other road users, parking and charging: Autres usagers de la route, stationnement et recharge
fr.#<p>Questions about other drivers, parki: Questions sur les autres conducteurs, le stationnement et la recharge de votre véhicule.

de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich damit, wie Sie Fahrten mit Motorrad oder Roller erleben und wie Sie sich dabei fühlen. Ihre Antworten helfen uns, Hindernisse und Möglichkeiten für eine bessere städtische Mobilität zu erkennen. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft: Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf die verschiedenen SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren
de.#Do you ride a motorcycle, scooter or mo: Fahren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche Motorrad, Motorroller oder Moped, um irgendwohin zu gelangen? (E-Scooter zählen hier nicht: Sie werden im Fragebogen zum Radfahren behandelt.)
de.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Warum fahren Sie nicht oder so selten Motorrad oder Motorroller? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)

de.#I don't have a licence or a vehicle: Ich habe keinen Führerschein oder kein Fahrzeug
de.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: Es erscheint mir im Verkehr zu gefährlich
de.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Meine Gesundheit, eine Behinderung oder mein Alter machen es mir schwer
de.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Ich brauche es nicht: Andere Fortbewegungsarten passen besser zu mir
de.#How do traffic-calming features (e.g.,: Wie beeinflussen Maßnahmen zur Verkehrsberuhigung, zum Beispiel Bremsschwellen, Rüttelstreifen oder Fahrbahnverengungen, Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl beim Fahren?
de.#Rumble strips are raised or grooved lin: Rüttelstreifen sind erhöhte oder eingefräste Querstreifen auf der Fahrbahn, die Fahrzeuge vibrieren lassen. Eine Fahrbahnverengung ist eine Stelle, an der die Fahrbahn schmaler gemacht wird.
de.#No problem, I can handle these situatio: Kein Problem, ich komme mit diesen Situationen zurecht
de.#How do road surface conditions (pothole: Wie wirkt sich der Zustand der Fahrbahn (Schlaglöcher, Kopfsteinpflaster, Straßenbahnschienen) auf Ihr Fahren aus?
de.#I slow down or change my line, but I fe: Ich fahre langsamer oder ändere meine Linie, fühle mich aber sicher
de.#I often feel in danger: Ich fühle mich oft in Gefahr
de.#I avoid some roads because of their sur: Ich meide manche Straßen wegen ihres Belags, auch wenn der Weg länger ist
de.#In the last 12 months, have you fallen: Sind Sie in den letzten 12 Monaten wegen des Fahrbahnbelags gestürzt oder beinahe gestürzt?
de.#How confident are you in your ability t: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich darin, Unfälle durch plötzlich geöffnete Autotüren oder nicht kontrollierte tote Winkel zu vermeiden?
de.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: Der tote Winkel ist der Bereich um ein Fahrzeug, den die fahrende Person in den Spiegeln nicht sehen kann.
de.#<p>Questions about other drivers, parki: Fragen zu anderen Fahrenden, zum Parken und zum Laden Ihres Fahrzeugs.

tr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Motorcy: Motosiklet veya Scooter Deneyimi Anketine Hoş Geldiniz
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#<p>Questions about whether you ride a m: Motosiklet, scooter veya moped kullanıp kullanmadığınız ve yolun sürüşünüzü nasıl etkilediğiyle ilgili sorular.
tr.#Make me feel much less safe: Kendimi çok daha az güvende hissetmeme neden olur
tr.#Make me feel slightly less safe: Kendimi biraz daha az güvende hissetmeme neden olur
tr.#Make me feel slightly safer: Kendimi biraz daha güvende hissetmeme neden olur
tr.#Make me feel much safer: Kendimi çok daha güvende hissetmeme neden olur
tr.#How do parked cars or narrow lanes typi: Park etmiş otomobiller veya dar şeritler güzergâhınızda güvenli manevra yapabilmenizi genellikle nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Minor inconvenience, I adjust and manag: Küçük bir zorluk yaratır — uyum sağlar ve devam ederim
tr.#To what extent does the behavior of oth: Diğer sürücülerin ani şerit değiştirmesi, çok yakından takip etmesi veya yol vermemesi gibi davranışları sürüş sırasında stresinizi ne kadar etkiler?
tr.#Tailgating means following another vehi: Çok yakından takip, başka bir aracı çok kısa mesafeden izlemek demektir.
tr.#Moderately stressful, I notice it but m: Orta derecede stresli — fark ederim ama başa çıkabilirim
tr.#Very stressful, it frequently puts me o: Çok stresli — sık sık gergin hissetmeme neden olur
tr.#Extremely stressful, it significantly a: Son derece stresli — güvenli sürüş yapabilmemi ciddi biçimde etkiler
tr.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Şehrinizde motosiklet ve scooter için özel park imkânlarını ne kadar yeterli buluyorsunuz? Güvenli park yerlerini ve varış noktalarına yakın ayrılmış alanları düşünün.
tr.#To what extent does the presence of cha: Elektrikli motosiklet veya scooter için şarj istasyonlarının bulunması aracınızı kullanma isteğinizi ne ölçüde etkiler?
tr.#I don't have an electric vehicle, so th: Elektrikli aracım yok, bu nedenle bu soru benim için geçerli değil
tr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Bu SmartUrbanity anketi motosiklet veya scooter ile yolculuk ederken neler yaşadığınız ve nasıl hissettiğinizle ilgilidir. Yanıtlarınız, daha iyi kentsel hareketlilik için engelleri ve iyileştirme fırsatlarını belirlememize yardımcı olur. Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez: farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtların birlikte analiz edilebilmesi için e-posta adresinizden türetilen takma adlı bir kodla saklanır.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
tr.#Do you ride a motorcycle, scooter or mo: Bir yerlere gitmek için haftada en az bir kez motosiklet, scooter veya moped kullanıyor musunuz? (Elektrikli scooterlar burada sayılmaz: bisiklet anketinde ele alınıyorlar.)
tr.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Motosiklet veya scooter neden kullanmıyorsunuz ya da neden bu kadar az kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Bunu, farklı kişiler için motosiklet ve scooter kullanımını neyin sınırladığını anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır; belirtmemeyi de seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: Kötü yol yüzeyleri (çukurlar, parke taşları, tramvay rayları)
tr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Sağlığım, bir engelim veya yaşım bunu zorlaştırıyor
tr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Gerek duymuyorum: başka ulaşım yolları bana daha uygun
tr.#How do traffic-calming features (e.g.,: Hız kesici, titreşim şeridi veya yol daraltmaları gibi trafiği yavaşlatan uygulamalar sürüş sırasında güvenlik hissinizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Rumble strips are raised or grooved lin: Titreşim şeritleri, yol boyunca enine uzanan ve araçları titreştiren kabartmalı ya da oluklu çizgilerdir. Yol daraltması, taşıt yolunun daraltıldığı noktadır.
tr.#No problem, I can handle these situatio: Sorun değil, bu durumlarla başa çıkabiliyorum
tr.#How do road surface conditions (pothole: Yol yüzeyinin durumu (çukurlar, parke taşları, tramvay rayları) sürüşünüzü nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#I slow down or change my line, but I fe: Yavaşlıyorum veya şeridimi değiştiriyorum ama kendimi güvende hissediyorum
tr.#I avoid some roads because of their sur: Güzergâh daha uzun olsa bile yüzeyi nedeniyle bazı yollardan kaçınıyorum
tr.#In the last 12 months, have you fallen: Son 12 ay içinde yol yüzeyi yüzünden düştünüz mü ya da düşmek üzere oldunuz mu?
tr.#How confident are you in your ability t: Aniden açılan otomobil kapıları veya sürücülerin kör noktayı kontrol etmemesi nedeniyle oluşabilecek kazalardan kaçınma konusunda kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: Kör nokta, bir aracın çevresinde sürücünün aynalarda göremediği alandır.
tr.#Other road users, parking and charging: Diğer Yol Kullanıcıları, Park ve Şarj
tr.#<p>Questions about other drivers, parki: Diğer sürücüler, park ve aracınızın şarjı hakkında sorular.

fa.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Mo: SmartUrbanity - تجربه شما با موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر
fa.#6. Your Experience With Motorcycle Trav: 6. تجربه شما با موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر
fa.#Welcome to Your Experience With Motorcy: به پرسشنامه تجربه موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر خوش آمدید
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>Questions about whether you ride a m: پرسش‌هایی دربارهٔ اینکه آیا موتورسیکلت، اسکوتر موتوری یا موتور گازی می‌رانید و وضعیت جاده چه اثری بر رانندگی شما دارد.
fa.#Make me feel much less safe: باعث می‌شود خیلی کمتر احساس امنیت کنم
fa.#Make me feel slightly less safe: باعث می‌شود کمی کمتر احساس امنیت کنم
fa.#No effect on my safety: بر احساس امنیت من اثری ندارد
fa.#Make me feel slightly safer: باعث می‌شود کمی بیشتر احساس امنیت کنم
fa.#Make me feel much safer: باعث می‌شود خیلی بیشتر احساس امنیت کنم
fa.#How do parked cars or narrow lanes typi: خودروهای پارک‌شده یا خط‌های باریک معمولاً چه اثری بر توانایی شما برای مانور ایمن در مسیر دارند؟
fa.#Minor inconvenience, I adjust and manag: کمی مزاحمت ایجاد می‌کند؛ خودم را با شرایط هماهنگ می‌کنم
fa.#To what extent does the behavior of oth: رفتار سایر رانندگان، مانند تغییر ناگهانی خط، حرکت خیلی نزدیک یا راه ندادن، تا چه اندازه بر استرس شما هنگام رانندگی اثر دارد؟
fa.#Tailgating means following another vehi: حرکت خیلی نزدیک یعنی دنبال کردن وسیلهٔ دیگری با فاصلهٔ بسیار کم.
fa.#Not stressful at all, it doesn't affect: اصلاً استرس‌زا نیست؛ اثری بر من ندارد
fa.#Slightly stressful, it occasionally bot: کمی استرس‌زا است؛ گاهی آزارم می‌دهد
fa.#Moderately stressful, I notice it but m: تا حد متوسط استرس‌زا است؛ متوجه می‌شوم اما مدیریت می‌کنم
fa.#Very stressful, it frequently puts me o: خیلی استرس‌زا است؛ اغلب مرا مضطرب می‌کند
fa.#Extremely stressful, it significantly a: بسیار استرس‌زا است؛ توانایی من برای رانندگی ایمن را به‌طور جدی کم می‌کند
fa.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: امکانات پارک مخصوص موتورسیکلت و اسکوتر در شهر شما چقدر مناسب است؟ پارک امن و محل‌های مشخص نزدیک مقصد را در نظر بگیرید.
fa.#To what extent does the presence of cha: وجود ایستگاه شارژ برای موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر برقی تا چه اندازه بر تمایل شما به استفاده از وسیله‌تان اثر دارد؟
fa.#I don't have an electric vehicle, so th: وسیله برقی ندارم، پس این موضوع برای من کاربرد ندارد
fa.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
این پرسشنامه SmartUrbanity درباره احساس و تجربه شما هنگام رفت‌وآمد با موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر است. پاسخ‌های شما به ما کمک می‌کند موانع و فرصت‌های بهبود جابه‌جایی شهری را شناسایی کنیم. شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود: پاسخ‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما ساخته می‌شود ذخیره می‌شوند تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید
fa.#Do you ride a motorcycle, scooter or mo: آیا دست‌کم هفته‌ای یک بار برای رفت‌وآمد موتورسیکلت، اسکوتر موتوری یا موتور گازی می‌رانید؟ (اسکوتر برقی ایستاده در اینجا حساب نمی‌شود: در پرسشنامهٔ دوچرخه به آن پرداخته شده است.)
fa.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: چرا از موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر موتوری استفاده نمی‌کنید یا چرا این‌قدر کم استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#We ask this to understand what limits t: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم چه چیزی استفاده از موتورسیکلت و اسکوتر را برای افراد مختلف محدود می‌کند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و می‌توانید ترجیح دهید آن را نگویید.
fa.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: در ترافیک به نظرم خیلی خطرناک است
fa.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: سطح نامناسب جاده (چاله، سنگ‌فرش، ریل تراموا)
fa.#My health, a disability or my age makes: وضعیت سلامتی، معلولیت یا سنم این کار را دشوار می‌کند
fa.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: نیازی ندارم: روش‌های دیگر جابه‌جایی برایم مناسب‌ترند
fa.#How do traffic-calming features (e.g.,: عناصر آرام‌سازی ترافیک مانند سرعت‌گیر، نوار لرزاننده یا باریک‌سازی سواره‌رو چه اثری بر احساس امنیت شما هنگام رانندگی دارد؟
fa.#Rumble strips are raised or grooved lin: نوارهای لرزاننده خطوط برجسته یا شیاردار عرضی روی خیابان هستند که وسایل نقلیه را به لرزش درمی‌آورند. باریک‌سازی سواره‌رو نقطه‌ای است که عرض خیابان در آن کمتر شده است.
fa.#No problem, I can handle these situatio: مشکلی نیست، از پس این شرایط برمی‌آیم
fa.#I avoid these stretches of road: از این بخش‌های خیابان دوری می‌کنم
fa.#How do road surface conditions (pothole: وضعیت سطح جاده (چاله، سنگ‌فرش، ریل تراموا) چه تأثیری بر رانندگی شما دارد؟
fa.#I slow down or change my line, but I fe: سرعتم را کم می‌کنم یا مسیر حرکتم را تغییر می‌دهم، اما احساس امنیت می‌کنم
fa.#I avoid some roads because of their sur: به خاطر سطح بعضی جاده‌ها از آن‌ها دوری می‌کنم، حتی اگر مسیر طولانی‌تر شود
fa.#In the last 12 months, have you fallen: در ۱۲ ماه گذشته آیا به خاطر سطح جاده زمین خورده‌اید یا نزدیک بوده زمین بخورید؟
fa.#How confident are you in your ability t: در جلوگیری از تصادف ناشی از باز شدن ناگهانی در خودرو یا بررسی نکردن نقطه کور توسط رانندگان چقدر به توانایی خود اطمینان دارید؟
fa.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: نقطهٔ کور بخشی از اطراف خودرو است که راننده نمی‌تواند آن را در آینه‌ها ببیند.
fa.#Other road users, parking and charging: دیگر کاربران جاده، پارک و شارژ
fa.#<p>Questions about other drivers, parki: پرسش‌هایی دربارهٔ رانندگان دیگر، پارک و شارژ وسیلهٔ نقلیهٔ شما.

hu.#Welcome to Your Experience With Motorcy: Üdvözöljük a motorkerékpáros vagy robogós tapasztalatokról szóló kérdőívben
hu.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Válaszát rögzítettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt a kérdőív kitöltésére.
hu.#<p>Questions about whether you ride a m: Kérdések arról, hogy vezet-e motorkerékpárt, robogót vagy segédmotoros kerékpárt, és hogyan befolyásolja az út a vezetését.
hu.#How do parked cars or narrow lanes typi: Hogyan befolyásolják általában a parkoló autók vagy a keskeny sávok azt, hogy biztonságosan tudjon manőverezni az útvonalán?
hu.#To what extent does the behavior of oth: Mennyire növeli a stresszét más járművezetők viselkedése, például a hirtelen sávváltás, a túl szoros követés vagy az elsőbbség meg nem adása?
hu.#Tailgating means following another vehi: A túl szoros követés azt jelenti, hogy valaki nagyon kis távolságra halad egy másik jármű mögött.
hu.#Moderately stressful, I notice it but m: Közepesen stresszes — észreveszem, de tudom kezelni
hu.#Extremely stressful, it significantly a: Rendkívül stresszes — jelentősen rontja a biztonságos vezetési képességemet
hu.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Mennyire megfelelőek a motorkerékpárok és robogók számára kialakított parkolási lehetőségek a városában? Gondoljon a biztonságos és az úti célokhoz közeli kijelölt helyekre.
hu.#To what extent does the presence of cha: Mennyire befolyásolja az elektromos motorkerékpárok vagy robogók töltőállomásainak elérhetősége azt, hogy szívesen használja-e a járművét?
hu.#I don't have an electric vehicle, so th: Nincs elektromos járművem, ezért ez nem vonatkozik rám
hu.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Ez a SmartUrbanity kérdőív arról szól, hogyan érzi magát és mit tapasztal motorkerékpárral vagy robogóval közlekedve. Válaszai segítenek feltárni a városi közlekedés akadályait és fejlesztési lehetőségeit. A részvétel önkéntes. Válaszai nem kapcsolódnak a nevéhez: egy, az e-mail-címéből képzett álnevesített kóddal tároljuk őket, hogy a különböző SmartUrbanity-kérdőívekre adott válaszait együtt lehessen elemezni.

További információ a SmartUrbanity projektről
hu.#Do you ride a motorcycle, scooter or mo: Vezet motorkerékpárt, robogót vagy segédmotoros kerékpárt legalább hetente egyszer, hogy eljusson valahová? (Az elektromos roller itt nem számít: arról a kerékpáros kérdőív szól.)
hu.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Miért nem motorozik vagy robogózik, vagy miért csak ilyen ritkán? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mi korlátozza a motor és a robogó használatát a különböző emberek számára. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és azt is választhatja, hogy nem kívánja megadni.
hu.#Heat or bad weather: A hőség vagy a rossz idő
hu.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Az egészségi állapotom, egy fogyatékosság vagy a korom megnehezíti
hu.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Nincs rá szükségem: más közlekedési módok jobban megfelelnek nekem
hu.#How do traffic-calming features (e.g.,: Hogyan befolyásolják a forgalomlassító elemek, például fekvőrendőrök, rezgőcsíkok vagy úttest-szűkítések a biztonságérzetét vezetés közben?
hu.#Rumble strips are raised or grooved lin: A rezgőcsíkok az úttesten keresztben futó kiemelt vagy bemart sávok, amelyek megrezegtetik a járműveket. Az úttest-szűkítés olyan pont, ahol az úttestet keskenyebbé teszik.
hu.#No problem, I can handle these situatio: Nem probléma, meg tudom oldani ezeket a helyzeteket
hu.#How do road surface conditions (pothole: Hogyan befolyásolja az útburkolat állapota (kátyúk, macskakő, villamossínek) a motorozását?
hu.#I slow down or change my line, but I fe: Lassítok vagy módosítom az íveimet, de biztonságban érzem magam
hu.#I avoid some roads because of their sur: Egyes utakat a burkolatuk miatt elkerülök, még ha hosszabb is az útvonal
hu.#In the last 12 months, have you fallen: Az elmúlt 12 hónapban elesett vagy majdnem elesett az útburkolat miatt?
hu.#How confident are you in your ability t: Mennyire érzi magát magabiztosnak abban, hogy elkerülje a hirtelen kinyíló autóajtó vagy a holttér ellenőrzésének elmulasztása miatt kialakuló balesetet?
hu.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: A holttér a jármű körüli terület, amelyet a vezető nem lát a tükrökben.
hu.#<p>Questions about other drivers, parki: Kérdések a többi járművezetőről, a parkolásról és a járműve töltéséről.

ar.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Mo: SmartUrbanity - تجربتك مع الدراجة النارية أو السكوتر
ar.#6. Your Experience With Motorcycle Trav: 6. تجربتك مع الدراجة النارية أو السكوتر
ar.#Welcome to Your Experience With Motorcy: مرحبًا بك في استبيان تجربة الدراجة النارية أو السكوتر
ar.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: تم تسجيل إجابتك. شكرًا لوقتك في إكمال هذا الاستبيان.
ar.#<p>Questions about whether you ride a m: أسئلة حول ما إذا كنت تقود دراجة نارية أو سكوترًا أو دراجة بخارية صغيرة، وكيف يؤثر الطريق في قيادتك.
ar.#How do parked cars or narrow lanes typi: كيف تؤثر السيارات المتوقفة أو الحارات الضيقة عادةً في قدرتك على المناورة بأمان على طريقك؟
ar.#To what extent does the behavior of oth: إلى أي مدى يؤثر سلوك السائقين الآخرين، مثل تغيير الحارة فجأة أو القيادة قريبًا جدًا أو عدم إعطاء الأولوية، في مستوى التوتر لديك أثناء الرحلة؟
ar.#Tailgating means following another vehi: القيادة قريبًا جدًا تعني السير خلف مركبة أخرى على مسافة قصيرة جدًا.
ar.#Not stressful at all, it doesn't affect: غير مسبب للتوتر إطلاقًا — لا يؤثر فيّ
ar.#Moderately stressful, I notice it but m: مسبب للتوتر بدرجة متوسطة — ألاحظه لكنني أتعامل معه
ar.#Very stressful, it frequently puts me o: مسبب للتوتر كثيرًا — يجعلني متوترًا غالبًا
ar.#Extremely stressful, it significantly a: مسبب للتوتر بدرجة كبيرة جدًا — يؤثر بشكل واضح في قدرتي على القيادة بأمان
ar.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: ما مدى ملاءمة أماكن الوقوف المخصصة للدراجات النارية والسكوتر في مدينتك؟ فكر في المواقف الآمنة والأماكن المخصصة بالقرب من الوجهات.
ar.#To what extent does the presence of cha: إلى أي مدى يؤثر توفر محطات شحن للدراجات النارية أو السكوتر الكهربائية في رغبتك في استخدام مركبتك؟
ar.#I don't have an electric vehicle, so th: ليس لدي مركبة كهربائية، لذلك لا ينطبق هذا عليّ
